items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: I told him if they take Lil Jack's picture

ctx.x: You know what picture we want, bro? If you can get a picture? Somebody with a picture of Chris Kelly.
All right. I'mma see can I get Chris Kelly's picture. I told him if they take Lil Jack's picture,

just hook a trumpet on it or something. Take it? He saw Lil Jack, look, this image. Just like him, huh? The image. I don't know if he can I get Chris Kelly, let's see who got that picture. You know all the people, that's what I say, you might run across somebody that has that picture. Wooden Joe's people might have Chris's picture.
